notes:
Context: Mid-market B2B analytics platform focused on customer insights and product personalization. Product team (PM + Eng) evaluating Redwood for low-latency chat/summarization in EU customers. Interested in starting on Hosted API (EU region) for quick time-to-value, then migrating to Dedicated (reserved GPU) for predictable throughput and lower unit cost.

Key technical requirements / quotes:
- "'EU data must stay in EU'" — legal and customer contracts require data residency for all PII and derived embeddings.
- SSO/SAML + audit logs + KMS integration required for production.
- Target throughput: 40-60 QPS for embeddings + 10-20 concurrent chat sessions.
- Latency SLO: P95 < 250ms for simple completions, end-to-end 300-400ms for chat with context.
- Cost sensitivity: want committed monthly ARR discount; debating 6 vs 12 month commit.

POC / Demo notes:
- 2026-01-12: Intro demo (hosted API) w/ AE (Hannah) + SE (Diego). Positive reaction to streaming and embeddings quality.
- 2026-01-20: Sent POC test plan + sample datasets (anonymized), requested EU-hosted endpoints + telemetry.
- 2026-01-28: SE-led POC kickoff: Frankfurt region host, 7-day run to measure latency and throughput.
- 2026-02-10: POC interim: embeddings QPS steady ~45, median latency 110ms in FRA, tail P95 220ms. Observed small increase when KV cache warmup occurs.
- 2026-02-15: Pricing call with finance: preference for Dedicated reserved pool with burst capacity; asked for 20% ARR discount on 12-month commit.

Multi-region / residency discussion:
- Primary: EU region (Frankfurt) to satisfy residency.
- Fallback: UK/US for overflow during bursts — legal requires clear data routing and opt-out. Need routing policy that keeps embeddings/data in EU for persisted artifacts; ephemeral fallbacks acceptable if no storage.
- Latency tradeoffs: FRA <-> US fallback adds ~80-120ms network delta; acceptable for non-PII requests but not for persisted embeddings. Engineering wants ability to route by request tag (residency_required=true).

Open items / next steps:
- Provide Dedicated pricing sheet for 12-month commit with burst option (AI ops asked).
- Confirm KMS integration pattern and sample audit log output for security review. Drive link: drive:/security/flowgrid/security-reqs.md referenced.
- SE to run 48h focused P95 test under realistic traffic patterns and validate multi-region routing config (expected by 2026-02-25).
- Legal to review residency routing doc; need signoff before procurement.

AE notes / tone: Short, pragmatic team; product org wants low-friction Hosted API to demo feature to customers next quarter but procurement leans to Dedicated for cost predictability. Follow-up meeting scheduled w/ finance + engineering (2026-02-22).
